item.title: C/C++ Preprocessor Techniques for Counting Variadic Macro Arguments
item.description:
“C/C++ Preprocessor Techniques for Counting Variadic Macro Arguments”

How can a developer reliably ascertain the quantity of arguments supplied to a variadic macro (__VA_ARGS__) in C or C++? Since the preprocessor lacks a direct function for this, several creative, often compiler-dependent, techniques have been devised. We look at robust methods, spanning C99 features to C++11 templates and traditional preprocessor trickery.

Solution Set 1: C99 Feature - Array Sizing Trick

A common C99 approach leverages the flexibility of Variable Length Arrays (VLA) within initializer lists, combined with the sizeof operator to deduce the count.
